items.title: New GTA 6 'MACCA & FRIENDS' In-Game Trailer Revealed
items.summary: A 30-second trailer shows an in-game animated series that will air on the in-game WEAZEL network from November 19.

items.title: GTA 6 First Update Released Ahead of Launch
items.summary: Rockstar pushed the mandatory Update 1.002.000, about 1 GB, to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, rolling it out to 50% of users first.

items.title: GTA 6 Has 'Far Too Much Genital Exposure,' According To South Korean Regulators
items.summary: Korean rating-board proceedings show GTA 6 nearly got a rating refusal over nudity before the committee voted 8-1 for an Adults Only rating.

items.title: The 'GTA 6' Physical Edition Is Missing More Than Just Its Disc
items.summary: Forbes looks at the boxed GTA 6 release, which has no game on the disc, with the 210GB install and an expected day-one patch.

items.title: GTA 6 Preloading Is Causing Major Download Traffic Spikes in Europe
items.summary: Preloading is reportedly driving large download traffic spikes across Europe.

items.title: Brand-New GTA 6 Footage Released
items.summary: Rockstar reposted a clip from the Only in Dade Instagram account, confirming it was recorded in-game and showing cars from the West Coast Customs collaboration.

items.title: Full GTA 6 Map Leaked Online From Collector's Box
items.summary: Images of the full printed Leonida map from the Collector's Box, claimed to come from a Selfridges employee, are circulating online and show previously unknown areas.

items.title: Palworld Dev Gives All Employees a GTA 6 Holiday Lasting Five Days
items.summary: Pocketpair has given every employee five days of special leave to play GTA 6 when it launches on November 19.

items.title: GTA 6 Unlocks At Midnight On November 19, But Millions Of Americans Can Start Playing The Night Before
items.summary: Forbes breaks down US unlock times by time zone, showing western regions can start playing on the evening of November 18.

items.title: Kick's GTA 6 Promotion is Giving Away 'Thousands of Free Copies'
items.summary: Kick is giving away thousands of free GTA 6 codes to viewers who scan a QR code on its promo truck or watch streams for three hours.
